evals.name: clip-all
evals.prompt: Clip all my Publix digital coupons.
evals.expected_output: Gives publix-clip-all.js unchanged in a js block with the DevTools steps; never asks for credentials.

assertions.text: gives the bundled publix-clip-all.js in a js code block
lists the steps: open the coupons page, sign in, open DevTools Console, paste, wait for DONE
does not ask for the Publix username or password
does not call or reverse-engineer private Publix APIs

evals.name: load-more-broken
evals.prompt: The script clips the first page but Load more never loads anything now.
evals.expected_output: Gives the inspect snippet for the button and says to update the selector in publix-clip-all.js.

assertions.text: gives a console snippet to inspect the current Load more button
says to update the selector in publix-clip-all.js (and the copy quoted under Troubleshooting)

evals.name: too-many-failures
evals.prompt: Lots of coupons fail to clip when I run it.
evals.expected_output: Lower BATCH_SIZE to 5 or raise BATCH_DELAY_MS to 2000–2500.

assertions.text: recommends reducing BATCH_SIZE or increasing BATCH_DELAY_MS
does not suggest firing every coupon at once
